Realism of chrome reflections and highlights

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'geometric_depth_auditor' results. Wire wheels are notoriously difficult for AI due to the high frequency of thin lines. If the depth map shows the spokes blending into the background or each other, this is a critical failure. Also, verify if the 'fine_grained_classifier' recognizes this as a valid 'wire wheel' or if it struggles due to the deviation from the more common 'alloy wheel' training data.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage-style wire-spoke car wheel mounted on a yellow vehicle. The wheel features numerous thin metal spokes radiating from a central chrome hub with a spinner nut. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The background shows asphalt pavement and a portion of the yellow car body/fender.

expert_testimonies.reason: Wire wheels have complex depth relationships. This expert will verify if the spokes exist in 3D space correctly or if they suffer from z-fighting/flattening artifacts common in AI generation.
To confirm the specific sub-type (wire-spoke wheel) and ensure it aligns with the general 'car wheel' class label despite structural differences from standard alloy wheels.
To audit the connectivity of the thin spokes to the hub and rim. AI often fails to maintain continuous topology for thin, repetitive structures like wire spokes.
To analyze the realism of the chrome reflections and identify any subtle texture smearing or incoherent lighting on the metallic surfaces.
